paper_excerpt: Impact of Acute Endurance Exercise on Alternative Splicing in Skeletal Muscle. Twenty mice underwent acute treadmill running for 30 minutes. Gastrocnemius muscles were collected pre-exercise, immediately post-exercise, 1 hour post-exercise, and 24 hours post-exercise, with five animals at each time point. Oxford Nanopore long-read RNA sequencing was performed. TALON was used to quantify reads and generate an abundance matrix. The mouse data are deposited in GEO under GSE279359.
